experiences.summary: Building Cathay Pacific's customer-facing online check-in system with Angular + Node.js BFF under an English agile workflow.
details: Develop modern Angular frontend modules for passenger-facing online check-in flows.
Contribute to Node.js BFF API composition and data filtering between frontend flows and backend services.
Integrate Scandit-based document scanning for passports, Hong Kong/Macau permits, China residence permits and visas.
Troubleshoot production issues with analytics and Kibana signals, connecting user behavior to system-level root causes.
Work in a two-week Sprint cadence across Planning, Review and Retrospective; join Refinement / Story Grooming to clarify backlog scope.
Support UAT and regression testing while preserving buffer for urgent production or requirement changes.
Use GitHub Copilot, Claude and AI-agent review patterns to accelerate delivery while keeping human review discipline.
experiences.impact: A heavy enterprise travel workflow presented as clear, resilient customer-facing interactions.

experiences.summary: Led iCluster Web product development across Angular, Tailwind CSS and Spring Boot, including product prototyping and Angular upgrade work.
details: Led iCluster Web development with Angular, Tailwind CSS and Spring Boot.
Learned the JHipster toolchain and encapsulated Keycloak-related capabilities in Spring Boot to improve usability.
Analyzed requirements and used Figma to design product improvement prototypes.
Researched and planned an Angular upgrade from 13 to 15, including risk assessment, performance and developer-experience improvements.
experiences.impact: Product-facing full-stack work: from requirements and prototypes to framework upgrades and backend integration.

details: Developed dynamic form features with Angular, NG-ZORRO, RxJS, NestJS and TypeORM.
Built mini-program and PC-side clinic project features for AstraZeneca with Uniapp and reusable common components.
Encapsulated business component libraries and frontend layout components based on ABP projects to improve reuse.
Handled effort estimation, task assignment, Code Review and mentoring for junior engineers.
experiences.impact: Combined hands-on delivery with component reuse, estimation and team-level engineering support.

Researched Vue CLI upgrade paths for shared team plugins compatible with @vue/cli 4.
Quickly learned the MPX framework and delivered WeChat mini-program features on schedule.
experiences.impact: Fast-moving consumer frontend delivery with high UI fidelity and quick adaptation to new internal frameworks.
